resources.string: Checking USB debugging…
USB debugging is off. Turn it on in Developer options, then come back.
Shizuku is installed but hasn\'t allowed Lounge yet. Choose Use Shizuku instead, or turn on USB debugging.
Power Setup isn\'t connected. In Settings, open Power Setup and choose Connect.
The TV allowed Lounge just this once. Choose Connect again, and tick “Always allow” on the TV\'s prompt.
Power Setup couldn\'t run that. Try again.
This TV doesn\'t let USB debugging do that. Look in Developer options for a setting that allows it, then try again.
This TV\'s version of Android has no command for that, so Lounge can\'t do it here.
Android protects that app, so it can\'t be turned off.
The TV didn\'t do that. Try again.
Device %1$s
Make Lounge the home screen
Pressing Home brings Lounge up; the TV\'s own home screen stays installed.
Allow TV listings
Lets Lounge see what you were watching, channels and the TV guide.
Allow notification access
Lets Lounge see what is playing, control it, and show what apps want to tell you.
Allow usage access
Lets Your apps follow what you open.
Show pop-ups over other apps
Lets a ring at the door show while you watch something else.
Faster system animations
Halves the TV\'s own animations, so its menus and apps open quicker.
Normal system animations
Puts the TV\'s own animations back to their usual length.
Optimise Lounge now
Prepares Lounge now so it opens and scrolls faster, as the TV would overnight.
Turn off %1$s
Android opens it before any chosen home. It stays installed and can be turned back on here.
Turn %1$s back on
Do this before uninstalling Lounge, or the TV has no home screen to fall back on.
Use Lounge as the screensaver
Makes Lounge\'s the screensaver the TV starts when it is left idle.
Back to the previous screensaver
Puts the system screensaver back the way it was.
Wake the TV and switch to me
Turns the TV on and switches it to Lounge.
TV power
Turns the TV on or off.
Everything off
Goes to sleep, and the TV turns off with it.
Sound through the soundbar
Plays the sound through the soundbar or receiver.
Sound through the TV
Plays the sound through the TV\'s own speakers.
Switch to %1$s
Switches the TV to %1$s.
